solution:

☛ Grammar Rule: Little is used with uncountable nouns, whereas few pairs with countable nouns. Here, "to do" (action) is uncountable, making little grammatically accurate.
☛ Other Options Rejected:
- Light: Pertains to physical light/weight, irrelevant here.
- Minute: Denotes time/tininess, contextually mismatched.
- Sparse: Indicates scarcity (e.g., population), meaningfully unfit.

Exam Tip: Note the difference between little (negative: hardly any) and a little (positive: some).
